mapper.select: SELECT sms.MATERIAL_CODE, sms.MATERIAL_DESC, sms.STANDARD_LENGTH, sms.STOCK FROM t_mdm_special_material_stock sms WHERE IFNULL(sms.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND sms.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND sms.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND sms.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MDM_SPECIAL_MATERIAL_RECORD smr WHERE IFNULL(smr.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND smr.MATERIAL_TYPE = '02' AND smr.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND smr.MATERIAL_CODE = sms.MATERIAL_CODE)
